title: Bachelor Fake Pregnancy: What Sentence?
description:
Laura Owens faked a pregnancy with twins. She used a fake ultrasound image and a fake pregnancy video, and she lied under oath in a paternity case she filed against a former reality-TV star. She was charged with 14 felonies and pleaded guilty to four counts.
Prosecutors recommended five years and five months in prison. On October 23, 2026, the Maricopa County Superior Court in Arizona sentenced her to 30 days in jail and seven years of probation. A deferred 12-month jail term applies if she violates probation. The judge said she seemed less a sophisticated con artist than "a very sad individual making some poor choices."
